title: Paw of the Broken Crown
description: A large, cracked, glowing orange paw rises from the ground like a monument, adorned with intricate silver filigree, fleur-de-lis patterns, and teal gemstones. Shattered crown fragments and broken stained-glass pieces float around it against a dark background, with stylized silver and teal plants growing from a fractured ground.
prompt: A monumental cracked glowing orange animal paw rises from the earth like a ancient relic, covered in intricate silver metalwork and fleur-de-lis patterns, embedded with teal gemstones. Shattered crown pieces and broken stained glass float in the dark air around it. Stylized silver and teal plants grow from a fractured ground of black stone and teal shards, dramatic lighting, dark fantasy stained glass aesthetic.
